reviews.review_description: The game is really good.. and the graphics are very realistic.. Overall I really enjoyed playing it.. The gameplay is fun...but I think the developers could make it even better by adding more playable charactersn similar to classic street fighters....It gives me the vibe of a Street Fighter style game.. which I really like... Looking forward to future updates!

developer_response.body: Thank you so much for your amazing review! 😊 We're really glad you're enjoying the graphics and gameplay. It's awesome to hear that our game gives you Street Fighter vibes! We also appreciate your suggestion about adding more playable characters. it's definitely something we're considering for future updates. Thanks again for your support, and we hope you enjoy the exciting new content coming soon! 🥊🔥

reviews.review_description:
This game hits different fr. Fought basically every fighter and I'm sweating so bad but it's so worth it lol. Love how the environments keep changing, keeps things fresh every match. Hard mode literally destroyed me the first time 💀 but that's what made it fun tbh.
Only thing missing is a training mode with a punching bag so we can practice combos before jumping into real fights. Add that and this game is literally perfect.

developer_response.body: We're glad you're enjoying the fights, different environments, and the challenge especially Hard mode! We really appreciate your suggestion about adding a Training Mode with a punching bag to practice combos before real matches. That's a great idea, and we'll definitely consider it for a future update. Thanks again for your support and happy boxing!

Hi Wyatt, thank you for purchasing our game. we're sorry to hear it didn't meet your expectations. Since you're a paying customer, your feedback means a lot to us. Could you share what specifically didn't work for you (bugs, missing features, performance issues, etc.)? Please reach out to us at sufwan.saleem.meta@gmail.com so we can help resolve the issue or discuss a refund if needed.

reviews.review_description: i played this game it i tried my absolute best to try and like it but i just can't because the physics are too bad make it so you can quit out of the fight

developer_response.body: Thank you so much for your valuable feedback! 🙏 Our team is working on improving the physics, graphics, and adding new game modes.
